overall_cefr_level.description: The overall CEFR level of the text.

root_name.description: The central root theme or core question of the unit.

branch_name.description: The name of the primary branch representing a major sub-theme or narrative stage.

color_theme.description: The color theme for this branch to visually group related ideas.

sub_branch_name.description: The name of the sub-branch. Leave empty ('') if this branch does not have nested sub-branches and the details/leaves should connect directly to the main branch.

leaves.description: A list of detailed points, key facts, or specific examples for this branch/sub-branch.

sub_branches.description: List of sub-branches. If a branch has no sub-categories, provide a single sub-branch with sub_branch_name set to '' and list the items in leaves.

branches.description: List of exactly 3 to 5 primary branches forming the first level of the mind map.
